description: Not a lever: a different weights file for the DFlash2 drafter. The served drafter fine-tuned on Swift-1.5's own greedy text (docs/tp4-swift-drafter.md): a local drafter manifest, its committed config, a drafter_checkpoints.json entry, the tau lab arm sw1ft-bf8 and the card pack. Default off: the default manifest (dedf8df6) and the production profile are untouched; the weights are not in the repository.

image_files.reason: the manifest of the candidate drafter; the image build reads it for the pins, the loader for every byte check
a local drafter has no hub repository: the build copies this committed config (hashed to the manifest's config_sha256) instead of fetching one
